# teams config set

Set a configuration value

## Usage

```
teams config set <key> [value] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `key` | Config key to set | Yes |
| `value` | Value to set. Omit to pick interactively. | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->

## Optional installation telemetry

`teams config set telemetry on` records explicit opt-in; `off` disables collection
and clears the installation ID. The default is off. `--json` is supported.
Production collection remains disabled pending release approval.

The MVP observes only npm postinstall hooks for previously enrolled installations,
not CLI command usage or confirmed installation. A fresh install sends nothing.
`DO_NOT_TRACK=1` and `TEAMS_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1` override enrollment.

Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement
